The '''AO14 net gun''', also nicknamed the '''Aranea''', was a model of short-ranged [[Net gun/Legends|net gun]] produced by [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]] that was worth 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the gun was officially classified as a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] and fired 40 [[Meter/Legends|millimeter]] entangling and spin-stabilizing shells. The munition consisted of weighted synthetic [[ArachSilk]] fine-mesh [[Net/Legends|netting]] which was tightly packed into each shell. The munitions released the net a preset distance after being fired, and the spin of the munition caused the net to unravel to its maximum width as it was released. The netting tightened around [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] or non-sentient targets that struggled within it which, combined with the high tensile strength of the net, made it difficult for targets to escape. The gun itself was heavy and squat in nature, similar in size to a small [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]]. It was built with a wide-gauge [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. With lightweight [[Polycarbonate/Legends|polycarbonate]] furniture, the gun was single shot, break-action and breach-loading.<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The AO14 was first mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2013]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game.<ref name="ETU" />
